speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The normal audiometry, migraine profiler, and lack of neck pain or head movement difficulty make central causes, Meniere's disease, or cervicogenic vertigo highly unlikely. The classic presentation of brief, spontaneous vertigo resolving to baseline is most consistent with BPPV.
